Maria: Heads-up — baseline 13B->int4 for long-context summarization shows +6% hallucination rate on GTN slice after KV warmstart. Details below.
Jordan: Ok what's the delta on ROUGE/QA? Is latency improved?
Maria: ROUGE-L -1.2, QA F1 -3.4, hallucination +6.1 points. TPS up 22%, token cost down 38% (estimate).
Alex: Any infra signals? mem spikes, OOMs?
Maria: No OOMs. KV hit rate dropped ~10% on our prefix-heavy workloads. Seen mostly after warmstart with long histories (>4k tokens).
Priya: Could be quantization drift on key/query projections. Did you run calibration with rolling stats?
Maria: We used per-tensor quant w/ 512 calibration steps. Command:
```
run_eval --model rdx-13b --quant int4 --calib 512 --slice long-context --kvcache warmstart
```
Sam-bot: perf snapshot uploaded: s3://rdw-ml/experiments/3100007777/snapshot.json
Jordan: Product impact: which GTN flows hit this? How bad for users?
Maria: Affects 'meeting-summary' heavy threads and 'docs-longform'. Failure mode is factual drift, not repetition. Short prompts unaffected.
Alex: Suggest routing: hybrid canary -> keep int8 for long-context, int4 for short. Can we do dynamic routing by input length?
Priya: Also try per-channel quantization for attention layers only. Quick ablation:
```
Ablation | ROUGE-L | F1 | Halluc
int8 | baseline | 0 | 0
int4-all | -1.2 | -3.4 | +6.1
int4-attn-only | -0.3 | -1.0 | +1.2
```
Maria: Good idea. Also KV-cache masking tweak recovered ~40% of halluc delta in a small replay.
Jordan: What's recommendation to GTN? Rollback or routing? Cost numbers?
Maria: Cost: int8 ~ $18 / 1M tokens, int4 ~ $11 / 1M tokens. For meeting-summary (avg 6k tokens/session) int4 saves ~$42k/month for 100k sessions. But risk of worse UX.
Jordan: Product preference: preserve fidelity for critical flows. Recommend mixed routing + A/B: 10% int4 to measure user metrics.
Alex: Ops: we can expose routing flag and a fallback policy. Need runbook for regression detection (ROUGE drop >1 or halluc >3 pts => auto rollback)
Priya: Eval plan: run 50k sample slices from production traffic, include human eval on 2k sessions focusing on hallucination taxonomy.
Maria: I'll push a canary: surfacing flag `use_int4_for_short` and `force_int8_for_long` and create GTN ticket.
Jordan: pls add priority label: P1 product-safety.
Maria: Created ticket: https://gtn.internal/issues/12345 (P1). Canaries start 03/11 10:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Deploy bot: canary started for flag use_int4_for_short on rdx-13b-int4 at 03/11 10:05 PT :rocket:
Alex: Monitoring: add alert on halluc_score > 2.5% increase over baseline for any 5m window.
Priya: Also schedule quant sweep with 1024 calib and scaled range clipping for QKV.
Maria: Thanks all — will post weekly snapshot and link to bench artifacts.
Jordan: Thanks. Keep product/GTN looped in.
